definitions.gloss: to tease; to make fun of; to kid
definitions.explanation: To playfully mock or joke with someone, often in a good-natured way but sometimes crossing into mean-spirited territory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧からかって⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I was playing around teasing my friend.

examples.japanese: からかわないで⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧、⟦{本気|ほんき}→本気：03153_honki⟧なんだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧。
examples.english: Don't tease me - I'm being serious!
He likes to make fun of new employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧からかったら⟦{泣|な}かれて→泣く：00655_naku⟧しまった。
examples.english: I teased my little brother and he ended up crying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧からかわれて⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧な⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I was often teased about my name and it was an unpleasant experience.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the person being teased.

USAGE:
からかう ranges from playful teasing between friends to more malicious mocking. Context and tone determine whether it's friendly or unkind.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧からかう (to tease someone)
- からかい⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (half-jokingly)
- からかわれる (passive: to be teased)

REGISTER:
Casual to neutral.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いじる→いじる：09373_ijiru⟧ - to tease/poke fun at (often in comedy contexts)
- ⟦ふざける→ふざける：09309_fuzakeru⟧ - to fool around/joke (focuses on the joking behavior itself)
- ひやかす - to tease/jeer (often about romantic interests)
- ⟦{冷|ひ}やかす→冷やかす：11728_hiyakasu⟧ - to make fun of, to jeer
